# Android App Updater

This directory contains the public `io.github.phillip9933:android-updater:1.0.0` release, including the matching source and license. The bundle SHA-256 is `13b0fa5df7524091191e063c9b25bdb4d222866053228754d98ea3f1d1e72763` and the source revision is `0613457c079d675dffcb4b5181e37959628cbbc4`. [Upstream v1.0.0 release](https://github.com/phillip9933/android-app-updater/releases/tag/v1.0.0)

The app resolves this module from the bundled Maven repository. The Gradle build checks the pinned upstream checksum manifest and verifies each file against it before resolving the dependency.
